summary: Andrea Kimi Antonelli arrives in Qatar with a commanding 98-point lead over Max Verstappen, needing only a steady performance to move within touching distance of the drivers' championship with one race remaining. Mercedes' constructors' lead of 149 points over Ferrari sets up a parallel battle for the teams' title, though tire management becomes critical as drivers face a 27-lap limit per set at the Lusail circuit. A victory for Antonelli or a dominant Mercedes showing would effectively seal both championships before the season finale in Abu Dhabi.
